_: Battle orders (Mac 2026-11-16: 'it would be awesome if game of crowns adhered to those formations'; docs/art/battle_formations, the approved pictures): how a side stands for a battle, one row each. rows: front to back, each takes up to `abreast` regiments of `role` (melee, ranged; melee falls back to whatever foot is left), `gap` before it (world units; army.json line.rowGap when absent), `line` its number (1 the front line, 2 a second line that relieves it). cells (field_cells.gd, Mac 2026-11-17: 'these are just different formations but they only move straight towards the enemy host'): step, ticks a man's step takes until the lines meet (the shield wall's long slow step, 2); back, cells the host steps straight back before it comes on (regroup), then stand, ticks it stands. After that every man keeps the field's one rule. army_formation.gd line_places reads rows; army_field.gd picks the order (pick).

pick._: battle_orders.gd pick: a commander's choice (utility scoring, as Total War's and Age of Empires' battle AIs weigh their options; Mac 2026-11-16: 'different strategies for different battles given the size of the other army, terrain etc', 'well thought of and not repetitive'). Each order scores base, plus outnumbered times how far it is outnumbered (1 - its men over the foe's, 0 when it is not), plus outnumbers times how far it outnumbers the foe, plus rise times how much higher its ground stands than the foe's (world units), plus foe_horse times the foe's share of horse, plus foot times its foot regiments past foot_from, plus horse times its own share of horse; less repeat when its house stood so last time; plus up to jitter at random. The highest wins.

command._: army_field.gd reorder, the King's orders in a battle (Total War's and Bannerlord's formation orders): the side comes on by the order from that moment (its cells traits, field_cells.gd order: a regroup steps back and stands, a shield wall comes on at its long slow step) under the order's guard (defence). buttons: the orders the bar offers; chosen: the word under the order it stands in; hints: each button's tooltip.
command.title: Orders

hints.line: Troops abreast, archers behind. All walk straight in.
hints.two_lines: A deep column. The men behind come round the sides.
hints.shield_wall: Shoulder to shoulder at half pace. Harder to break.
hints.regroup: Step back, stand a moment, then come on again.

_defence: orders.<key>.defence: army_combat.gd, how much better a regiment in that order stands against foot, a charge (horse) and arrows on its front (1 as it is): the shield wall's locked shields; the regroup's closed ranks. attack: how hard its men press their foe (a wall stands, it doesn't press).
